title: Democrats Push Data Center Restrictions After Midterm Wins
summary: After midterm election wins, prominent Democrats including Sen. Bernie Sanders are calling for restrictions on data centers and a "national data center moratorium," though these are proposals, not enacted policy. In the CNBC Voter Poll, 56% of voters said AI and data centers were a crucial or major factor in their vote, and 65% of that group said they backed a Democratic congressional candidate.
